description: E-Ladesäulen für Elektroautos Erkrath is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Erkrath. Location of the electric charging stations for electric cars in the city of Erkrath. An electric charging station is a device that supplies electric vehicles with electrical energy during their parking process. Coverage: Stadt Erkrath. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging stations for electric cars Erkrath" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Erkrath. Its keywords include Auto, Erkrath, Ladesäule, Elektroauto, TRAN, opendata. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
